feature: §7.3.10 direct/indirect equivalence for ordinary ExtGState values and nested arrays
source: Primary ISO 32000-2 §7.3.10, printed p. 34 / physical p. 49: any object value may be direct or indirect unless otherwise specified; semantics are equivalent. Table 57, printed pp. 165–167 / physical pp. 180–182, specifies ExtGState values. Its /Font array is an explicit exception: the font item shall be an indirect reference. EC3 amendments reviewed in this shard did not change the selected /D, /BM, /ca rules.
assertion_quality: Existing dash and deprecated blend-array tests use direct nested operands and assert consumer behavior. Existing resource/soft-mask tests include indirect top-level ExtGState or mask resources, but the reviewed assertions do not establish indirect dash-array members or indirect blend-name members plus indirect alpha. The code explicitly resolves these members. Two scratch-only direct-control versus indirect-target pixel tests are drafted.
verdict: implementation path appears to honor direct/indirect equivalence for sampled entries; no runtime failure established because drafts are not executed
residuals: Draft execution and broader nested soft-mask/transfer-function value coverage remain with parent.
This is sampled parameter-path evidence, not certification of all Table 57 fields or every ExtGState nesting shape.
